parole.significato: a Bavarian cheese delicacy. It is prepared by mixing one third aged camembert, one third aged Romadur cheese (60%) and…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Bavarian Obatzda and German Obatzda.

parole.significato: A pair of knee-breeches made of leather, typical of Bavaria and Austria.
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Lederhose (literally “leather trousers”). The final -n probably from the German plural; alternatively influenced by Bavarian Lederhosn (singular and plural).
